svg.text: Late tiles mark starts that still need at least 10 steps, or never settle by the cutoff. The question is what stays hot after the cutoff rises.
Low budget mixes real slow geometry with plain cutoff trouble.
The higher budget removes most cutoff noise. What survives is
What survives when the cutoff rises

text.tspan: Some low-budget drama was cutoff noise, but the repeated center critical point still leaves the more persistent slow core.
Orange intensity = local tail-or-cutoff share (≥ 10 steps or unresolved).
Dashed circle marks the unit circle; dashed crosshairs mark the origin.
